name: c-dusk
mode: image-to-video from site/assets/plates/business.webp, fit pad to 16:9, ending on site/assets/plates/business-night.webp
prompt: Exactly as in the image: a handmade miniature diorama of an Indian snack business seen from above in soft morning light, a pale factory with two brick chimneys and a small office at the left, a corrugated godown warehouse full of brown cartons in the middle, a lane of colourful kirana shops at the right, a highway climbing to a small warehouse on a hill at the back right, a community kitchen with a blue awning at the back, a fenced dump yard at the back left, and a thin softly glowing green path painted along the road. Over the clip a whole day passes from morning to night: the sunlight warms and lowers from the left, the shadows lengthen, the sky dims through gold and dusk to a deep blue night, and the windows of the factory, the godown, the kirana shops, the community kitchen and the warehouse light up one by one with warm light, the street lamps come on along the road, and the glowing green path grows brighter as the dark comes. Meanwhile the tiny yellow forklift carries a carton out of the godown and across the forecourt, the two workers at the table by the godown lift a carton between them, the small blue truck at the factory's loading bay pulls away along the road toward the godown and stops at its gate, tiny shoppers walk along the kirana lane and reach for packets at the shop fronts, the green auto-rickshaw drives slowly past the shops, the white van drives up the highway to the warehouse on the hill, people at the community kitchen move about, and the glowing green path brightens in one slow pulse from the godown along the road to the shops and up the hill, then settles. The clip ends on the night scene exactly as in the last image. Every building stays exactly where it is, with the same shape, size and colours; nothing new appears; no text appears anywhere. Locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. No flicker.
encode: ffmpeg -an -c:v libx264 -preset slow -profile:v high -crf 25 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart (from LTX's own H.264)
use: the hero film, option C: morning to night; chained with c-dawn without a cut (each ends on the frame the other begins on)
